title: Monotonicity of a dictator function
statement: For every natural number $n$, define $f$ on subsets of a one-element set by $f(S)=1$ if its unique element belongs to $S$, and $f(S)=0$ otherwise. Whenever $S\subseteq T$, one has $f(S)\le f(T)$.
hypotheses_covered: $S,T$ are subsets of the one-element set
